items.title: The category of etale neighbourhoods of a geometric point is cofiltered

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a scheme S and a geometric point sbar the category of etale neighbourhoods of sbar is cofiltered, and it spells this out as the existence of a common refinement of two neighbourhoods and of an equalizer of two parallel morphisms (statement lines 3261-3274). The two constructions are fibre products: U = U_1 x_S U_2 for the first part, and for the second the fibre product of U' -> U' x_S U' along the diagonal with the map (h_1, h_2), which is where the non-formal content lies, since one must see that (ubar, ubar') is a geometric point of that fibre product so that it is nonempty (proof lines 3284-3293). The remaining steps are the permanence properties of etale morphisms, combined so that U'' is etale over S. The claim is H2: two explicit constructions, short verifications.
